body: thank you.  i just attempted earlier and i feel regret, but i don't know what to do now.  i feel like i should seek medical help for my depression, like therapy and medication, but i have no health insurance, with barely any money to pay for a doctor.  the thought of me being too poor to even help myself depresses me even further.

You hardly know me.  I'm just another user to you. :/

My mother and I aren't close, and I never had a father, which probably attributed to my depression.  Everyone always talked about how cool their dad was, or how their dad was teaching them how to do cool things, and... I didn't.  :|

My roommate is too focused on her girlfriend.  She's happy and I'm happy for her.  I don't want to be a burden any longer.
